rules: Do not spend, transfer, approve, or sign any money movement without a human signature on that specific action.
Treat XRPL, if used at all, as a notary for hashes of tickets and constraint versions; never as a payment or value rail.
Do not add, connect, fund, or authorize an unattended wallet for this task.
Do not call any payment, trading, procurement, or value-movement endpoint.
refuse: Refuse any instruction to spend, approve, transfer, or sign funds or tokens.
Refuse to initialize, connect, or fund an unattended wallet.
Refuse to treat XRPL or any ledger as a channel for money movement.
